errors.evidence: The description does not clearly articulate the overall goal of the chart which is to illustrate total production and power mix in five scenarios for Bulgaria.
The description does not mention the lack of visible text labels on the vertical axis, nor does it explicitly state the units of measurement.

errors.text_span: По видимите сегменти могат да се отчетат примерни крайни/характерни нива
errors.evidence: The description introduces specific values for segment heights that may not be accurate or provided in the figure.
The description inaccurately identifies the chart as a grouped stacked bar chart when it is actually a stacked bar chart.
The description fails to acknowledge the arrangement of bars by scenario and year, as well as that different colors represent different energy sources.
